hooks.prompt: This workspace (OPS System + ERP System) is connected to LIVE PRODUCTION databases (AWS RDS aahaas-prod-*, 13.250.96.119:6033, production_live1, apple_booking_system, invoice_processor, MongoDB Atlas) with real booking, invoice and payment data. Inspect the command in $ARGUMENTS. Answer not-ok if it could destroy, reset, truncate, mass-update or mass-delete data, or drop/rename tables, columns or databases. Flag specifically: artisan migrate:fresh/reset/refresh/rollback, db:wipe, db:seed; prisma migrate reset, prisma db push (any form), prisma db seed; SQL DROP/TRUNCATE/ALTER ... DROP; DELETE or UPDATE without a precise WHERE clause (including inside tinker, mysql, psql, node -e, DB::statement, $executeRaw); MongoDB deleteMany({})/updateMany({})/drop/dropDatabase; running test suites (php artisan test, phpunit, npm test) against a non-local DB; starting queue workers, schedulers or mail/OneDrive pollers (queue:work, schedule:run, cron scripts) that would act on live data; printing .env secrets to output; git push --force. Ordinary reads, SELECT queries, file reads/edits, git status/diff/log, composer/npm install, lint, and build are ok.
